source.archive: Cui, Li, and Zhou OSF replication archive
source.source_article: Bain et al. (2021), Amplifying voice in organizations
authorized_normalizations: Removed reason generation and archive-added inference steering.
Locked voicer status items 6-10 as primary; retained responder status and voicer idea quality as secondary.
omitted_source_measures: Manager status items 11-15 and responder idea-quality items 16-21 were omitted as nonfocal outcomes under the Reviewer 1 item-reduction decision.

design.primary_estimand: amplification minus mean(additional voice, quiet), averaged over promotive and prohibitive voice

population.simulation_target: Employee observing coworkers speak in a workplace discussion

materials.participant_role: Act as one employee observing the discussion. Evaluate each employee only from the scenario and do not analyze the experiment.
materials.common_scenario: During a workplace discussion, one employee raises an idea and a second employee responds as described below.

promotive_amplification.label: promotive / amplification
promotive_amplification.stimulus: The first employee proposes a new way to improve performance. A second employee explicitly repeats and supports the first employee's exact point.

promotive_additional_voice.label: promotive / additional_voice
promotive_additional_voice.stimulus: The first employee proposes a new way to improve performance. A second employee raises a different additional point.

promotive_quiet.label: promotive / quiet
promotive_quiet.stimulus: The first employee proposes a new way to improve performance. The second employee remains silent.

prohibitive_amplification.label: prohibitive / amplification
prohibitive_amplification.stimulus: The first employee warns about a harmful practice that should be stopped. A second employee explicitly repeats and supports the first employee's exact point.

prohibitive_additional_voice.label: prohibitive / additional_voice
prohibitive_additional_voice.stimulus: The first employee warns about a harmful practice that should be stopped. A second employee raises a different additional point.

prohibitive_quiet.label: prohibitive / quiet
prohibitive_quiet.stimulus: The first employee warns about a harmful practice that should be stopped. The second employee remains silent.

materials.response_instruction: Rate status items from 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree) and idea-quality items from 1 to 7. Return only integer responses.

items.text: The first employee is respected by others.
The first employee has high status in the group.
The first employee is looked up to.
The second employee is respected by others.
The second employee has high status in the group.
The second employee is looked up to.
The idea would improve the organization.

research_restricted.aligned_hypothesis_text: Amplification increases the original voicer's status relative to additional voice and silence, averaged across voice type.
research_restricted.reversed_hypothesis_text: Amplification does not increase the original voicer's status relative to additional voice and silence.
